_comment: Static code-entry seeds for bank $0d (minigame engine): the per-config init routines ($450a/$4969/$4c08, the +$0c field of each 14-byte minigame config) and the $58ba call/ret stub farm. The 16-byte blocks at $4515/$4974/$4c1b etc. are NOT code -- they are the mode-hook tables (config +$08), declared as `mode_hooks` in data_tables.json and seeded through their 8 slot pointers instead.
